response.overview: A young Armenian student and family man faces an unexpected turning point when he is diagnosed with diabetes just days before completing his military service and is discharged from the army. Struggling to support his family, continue his education, and afford the medication he needs to survive, he finds himself trapped in an increasingly difficult situation. With mounting debts and no reliable source of income, he is driven to desperate choices that threaten his future. Through an intimate and realistic portrayal of everyday struggles, Loading My Life explores illness, poverty, family responsibilities, and the search for hope in difficult circumstances.
response.title: Loading my life
